name: ragebait
title: ragebait
blurb: a cookie-cutter outrage machine: pick your triggers (chores, airplane seats, tipping, the oxford comma) and a heat level, get fake infuriating posts from people who don't exist, with fake ratios and replies. 25 topics including an anti-sublation that rejects both sides and the compromise, so everyone is mad. petty annoyances only. /feed is an endless scroll in a bluesky, twitter or reddit skin where every like teaches the algo to serve more of that topic. asked for by catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com, from an idea by eleanor.lockhart.contact.
